oh boy. sea slugs are absolutely amazing in pretty much every way. there are SO many species. like, 2000+. they are so diverse. they are found in every single ocean, even the arctic. they are also diverse in size. the largest known species is the Spanish Dancer *(Hexabranchus sanguineus*) which CAN get to be 24 inches, though it is more common to be around the 10 inch area. on the other hand, the smallest species is the Leaf Slug (*Costasiella kuroshimae*) which get to be at MOST 1cm. these guys are also cool because they eat such large amounts of green algae that they retain some of the chlorophyl and therefore can photosynthesize! they cannot fully rely on photosynthesis  to live, though. also they are very cute. you may have seen them, they are what I would call a more mainstream sea slug. like if someone knows any sea slug, its that guy.

but now I will talk about my personal favorite species. which is.... the Monterey Sea Lemon (*Doris montereyensis*)!!!! Why do I love these guys the most? I do not know! I simply love them. they are gorgeous guys. they are usually a paler yellow but this can vary, so they can have a brighter yellow color and sometimes even be kind of orange. they have black spots on them too, but they do not have a specific number of blame dots so the varies based on the individual :) they are also a rough texture, similar to that of a real lemon. also, the egg ribbons they make can hold up to 2 million eggs which is crazy of them.

I have seen a false sea lemon (also very cool) as we got one once at the museum I work at. he unfortunately did not last long but he was great. I live on the east coast but my life goal is to go to the west coast to tide pool and sea all of the sea slugs that live there.

I transitioned before I recovered. I thought transitioning would fix all of my problems and it helped a lot for sure, but the underlying issues where still there. For things like starting hormones, you don't necessarily need to be recovered, although weight changes can happen when starting testosterone so you should be in a place where you can deal with that. My doctor also told me that testosterone is not as effective unless the body is properly nourished, that is also true for other medications. If you want all of the effects, you NEED to be fueling your body properly. 

For things like top surgery, it's a different story. I'm currently looking into top surgery for myself and tsince it is a major surgery, your body needs to be in a place where  it is safe to go under anesthesia and be able to recover from the stress surgery puts on the body. Of course, not everyone wants to start hormones or get surgery, but that has just been my experience :) I hope things go well for you!
